title: Where to Place Reviews and Testimonials on Your Website

cover.alt: Blank ceramic speech bubbles placed beside decision points along a miniature visitor path

figures.title: Match the review to the visitor's question
figures.summary: Different pages need different kinds of reassurance.

items.label: Homepage
items.detail: Brief attributed excerpts introduce the business.

items.label: Service page
items.detail: Relevant reviews address that specific service.

items.label: Contact page
items.detail: Short comments about communication sit near the form.

items.label: Review library
items.detail: A dedicated page offers more detail and source links.

figures.caption: The article's four placement roles; this is an information map, not conversion-test data.

figures.title: Make the testimonial verifiable
figures.summary: Preserve the customer's meaning and make the source clear.

items.label: Specific detail
items.detail: Use a genuine account of the service or experience.

items.label: Attribution
items.detail: Show the permitted name and source.

items.label: Permission
items.detail: Ask before publishing direct feedback with a customer's identity.

items.label: Source link
items.detail: Give visitors a way to inspect the original.

items.label: Faithful excerpt
items.detail: Do not remove criticism or rewrite the meaning.

figures.caption: Authenticity checks drawn from the article's usefulness and avoidance guidance.
